integrity: Claims supported by a direct factorial-moment proof and independently checked finite graph enumerations. These checks are self-review only, with no external or independent validation of mathematical correctness or bibliographic priority.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic theorem assumes uniformly bounded clique sizes and the critical S/(q-1)-log S regime. Fixed-palette counting follows from general color-frequency enumeration; it is included as verification, not independently claimed as original. Earlier chromatic-symmetric-function machinery may imply exact finite enumerations. No assertion is made for growing clique sizes or arbitrary block graphs.
title: A universal Poisson window for proper conflict-free clique-bouquet colorings
